```{r}
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Private.Service.Line.Material = case_when(
      Private.Service.Line.Material == "LEAD" ~ 1,
      Private.Service.Line.Material == "SUSPECTED LEAD" ~ NA,
      Private.Service.Line.Material == "NOT LEAD" ~ 0,
      Private.Service.Line.Material == "GALVANIZED REQUIRING REPLACEMENT" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )%>%
  drop_na(Public.Service.Line.Material, Private.Service.Line.Material)
```



convert to logit
```{r}
# Compute smoothed probabilities (rolling mean)
merged_data$y <- cumsum(merged_data$Public.Service.Line.Material + 0.5) / (seq_along(merged_data$Public.Service.Line.Material) + 1)

merged_data$y1 <- cumsum(merged_data$Private.Service.Line.Material + 0.5) / (seq_along(merged_data$Private.Service.Line.Material) + 1)

# Logit transformation
merged_data$logitpub <- log(merged_data$y / (1 - merged_data$y))

# Logit transformation
merged_data$logitpriv <- log(merged_data$y1 / (1 - merged_data$y1))




```

```{r}
  )
```

```{r}
# Load the libraries
library(spdep)
library(sf)         
library(tmap)       
library(ggplot2)    
library(RColorBrewer) 

chicago_sf <- st_read("C:/Users/vreid/Downloads/Neighborhoods_2012b_20250324/geo_export_03f0b53f-b4da-4d12-9e59-61338914d7b2.shp")

# Ensure valid geometries
chicago_sf <- st_make_valid(chicago_sf)

merged_sf <- st_as_sf(merged_data, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

merged_sf <- st_transform(merged_sf, crs = st_crs(chicago_sf))

nb_merged <- poly2nb(merged_sf, queen = TRUE)
weights_merged <- nb2listw(nb_merged, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

merged_data$SDM_pred <- as.numeric(predict(sdm_model, newdata = merged_sf, listw = weights_merged))


# Add predictions to the spatial data
merged_data$SAR_pred <- as.numeric(predict(sar_model, newdata = merged_data, listw = weights))
merged_data$SEM_pred <- as.numeric(predict(sem_model, newdata = merged_data, listw = weights))

# Define inverse logit function
inv_logit <- function(x) {
  exp(x) / (1 + exp(x))
}

# Predict logit values and transform back to probabilities

merged_data$Pred_Probpubsar <- inv_logit(merged_data$SAR_pred)
merged_data$Pred_Probpubsem <- inv_logit(merged_data$SEM_pred)
merged_data$Pred_Probpubsdm <- inv_logit(merged_data$SDM_pred)

# Add residuals
merged_data$SAR_resid <- as.numeric(residuals(sar_model))
merged_data$SEM_resid <- as.numeric(residuals(sem_model))
merged_data$SDM_resid <- as.numeric(residuals(sdm_model))
```

```{r}

# Load neighborhood polygon data
chicagosf <- read_csv("C:/Users/vreid/Downloads/Neighborhoods_2012b_20250222.csv")
chicago_sf <- chicagosf %>%
  mutate(geometry = st_as_sfc(the_geom)) %>%  # Convert to sf object
  st_as_sf(crs = 4326)  # Assign CRS

# Ensure valid geometries
chicago_sf <- st_make_valid(chicago_sf)

# Create neighborhood adjacency matrix
nb <- poly2nb(chicago_sf, queen = TRUE)
weights <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Load spatial predictor data
spatialpred <- read.csv("C:/Users/vreid/Downloads/Finaldatasetlast2.csv")
spatialpred <- spatialpred %>% drop_na(longitude, latitude)

# Convert point data to sf
predictors_sf <- st_as_sf(spatialpred, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# Merge spatial predictors with neighborhood polygons
merged_data <- st_join(predictors_sf, chicago_sf, join = st_within)
merged_data$Max <- as.numeric(merged_data$Max)

store <- merged_data %>%
  group_by(PRI_NEIGH) %>%
  summarise(Max_90th = quantile(Max, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE))
store_sf <- store %>%
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(merged_data), by = "PRI_NEIGH") %>%
  st_as_sf()

# Select predictor columns
predictor_cols <- c("Age", "Max", "Rooms", "tract_white_perc")
merged_data <- merged_data %>% drop_na(PRI_NEIGH)

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(PRI_NEIGH) %>%
  summarise(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  left_join(chicago_sf[, c("PRI_NEIGH", "geometry")], by = "PRI_NEIGH") %>%  # Use brackets for selection
  st_as_sf()  # Convert back to sf


# Ensure numeric variables are properly set
merged_data=st_join(merged_data,store_sf)




merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) %>%  # Remove rows where geometry is missing
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")  # Ensure correct geometry type

# OLS Model
ols_model <- lm(Max_90th ~ Age.x + tract_white_perc.x, data = merged_data, na.action = na.omit)
summary(ols_model)



merged_data <- st_as_sf(merged_data)

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  group_by(PRI_NEIGH.x) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Aggregate numeric values
            geometry = first(geometry))  # Keep one geometry per PRI_NEIGH

# Check for spatial autocorrelation in OLS residuals
nb <- poly2nb(merged_data, queen = TRUE)
weights <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Spatial Regression Models
sar_model <- lagsarlm(Max_90th ~ tract_white_perc.x + Bedrooms.x + Land.Square.Feet.x + 
                   Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land..x + Age.x, data = merged_data, listw = weights)
summary(sar_model)

sem_model <- errorsarlm(Max_90th ~ tract_white_perc.x + Bedrooms.x + Land.Square.Feet.x + 
                   Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land..x + Age.x, data = merged_data, listw = weights)
summary(sem_model)


sdm_model <- lagsarlm(Max_90th ~ tract_white_perc.x + Bedrooms.x + Land.Square.Feet.x + 
                   Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land..x + Age.x, 
                data = merged_data, listw = weights, Durbin = TRUE)
summary(sdm_model)


merged_data$SDM_pred <- as.numeric(predict(sdm_model, newdata = merged_data, listw = weights))


# Add predictions to the spatial data
merged_data$SAR_pred <- as.numeric(predict(sar_model, newdata = merged_data, listw = weights))
merged_data$SEM_pred <- as.numeric(predict(sem_model, newdata = merged_data, listw = weights))

```

```{r}
# Load necessary library
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Create a data frame with coefficients and confidence intervals
forest_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("(Intercept)", "tract_white_perc.x", "Land.Square.Feet.x", 
               "Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land..x", "Age.x"),
  Estimate = c(8.304, -0.7508, -3.847e-05, -2.958e-05, 0.0479),
  StdError = c(1.913, 1.497, 1.930e-05, 8.129e-06, 0.0215)
)

# Calculate 95% confidence intervals
forest_data <- forest_data %>%
  mutate(
    LowerCI = Estimate - 1.96 * StdError,
    UpperCI = Estimate + 1.96 * StdError
  )

# Create the forest plot
ggplot(forest_data, aes(y = Variable, x = Estimate)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "blue") +  # Plot estimates
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = LowerCI, xmax = UpperCI), height = 0.2, color = "black") +  # CI bars
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +  # Reference line at zero
  labs(title = "Forest Plot",
       x = "Coefficient Estimate ",
       y = "Predictor") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
  st_as_sf()  # Convert back to sf


# Ensure numeric variables are properly set
merged_data=st_join(merged_data,store_sf)




merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) %>%  # Remove rows where geometry is missing
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON")  # Ensure correct geometry type

# OLS Model
ols_model <- lm(Max_90th ~ Age.x + tract_white_perc.x, data = merged_data, na.action = na.omit)
summary(ols_model)



merged_data <- st_as_sf(merged_data)

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  group_by(PRI_NEIGH.x) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),  # Aggregate numeric values
            geometry = first(geometry))  # Keep one geometry per PRI_NEIGH

# Check for spatial autocorrelation in OLS residuals
nb <- poly2nb(merged_data, queen = TRUE)
weights <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Spatial Regression Models
sar_model <- lagsarlm(Max_90th ~ tract_white_perc.x + Bedrooms.x + Land.Square.Feet.x + 
                   Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land..x + Age.x, data = merged_data, listw = weights)
summary(sar_model)

sem_model <- errorsarlm(Max_90th ~ tract_white_perc.x + Bedrooms.x + Land.Square.Feet.x + 
                   Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land..x + Age.x, data = merged_data, listw = weights)
summary(sem_model)


sdm_model <- lagsarlm(Max_90th ~ tract_white_perc.x + Bedrooms.x + Land.Square.Feet.x + 
                   Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land..x + Age.x, 
                data = merged_data, listw = weights, Durbin = TRUE)
summary(sdm_model)


merged_data$SDM_pred <- as.numeric(predict(sdm_model, newdata = merged_data, listw = weights))


# Add predictions to the spatial data
merged_data$SAR_pred <- as.numeric(predict(sar_model, newdata = merged_data, listw = weights))
merged_data$SEM_pred <- as.numeric(predict(sem_model, newdata = merged_data, listw = weights))

```

```{r}
       x = "Longitude",
       y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)

# Filter the data to include only rows where 'Max' is from the third draw and >= 0.9
spatialpred_filtered <- spatialpred %>%
  filter(Max == Draw3, Max >= 0.9)

# Create a color palette based on Max values
pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "YlOrRd", domain = spatialpred_filtered$Max)

# Create a leaflet map with Max-based coloring
leaflet(spatialpred_filtered) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~longitude, ~latitude,
    color = ~pal(Max),        # Color based on Max value
    radius = 5,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.7
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "topright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~Max,
    title = "Max Value (>= 0.9 from Draw3)",
    opacity = 1
  )

```
